text: This demo uses synthetic data, and no real money moves.
When a patient is treated abroad, the people who help pay are far away.
In 2023, 28% of one Singapore hospital's bills missed the estimate.
say: In 2023, 28 percent of one Singapore hospital's bills missed the estimate.

text: Some hospitals billed pillowcases separately and marked up drugs by up to 300%.
say: Some hospitals billed pillowcases separately, and marked up drugs by up to 300 percent.

text: And one in four online fundraisers asks others to help with medical bills.
Guardian is an AI agent on the patient's side.
It explains the bill and pays only the hospital's verified account.
Rina opens a care case for Budi, a patient in Shenzhen.
callout: One place for bills, payments and records

text: Friends, relatives and a mosque fund join as payers.
callout: Each payer has a share limit

text: The hospital's account comes from its signed list, never from a document.
callout: Only the verified account can be paid

text: Before a file is read, Guardian checks its document type.
The interim bill is higher than the estimate, and Guardian shows why.
The stay was two days longer, which adds 3,000 yuan.
say: The stay was two days longer, which adds three thousand yuan.
callout: Every reason points to bill lines

text: A blood test billed twice becomes a question for the hospital.
Anyone can ask why, and the assistant answers with the case numbers.
callout: Numbers come from code, not guesses

text: For an emergency guarantee, the amount comes from the hospital's letter.
Three payers have already pledged 45,000 of the 50,000 yuan.
callout: Each payer sees only their own share
say: Three payers have already pledged forty five thousand of the fifty thousand yuan.

text: A mosque fund in Jakarta sees the rest in rupiah, with the rate and fee.
callout: Own currency, rate and fee shown

text: A pledge is a promise, and nothing is charged yet.
callout: Charged only when the owner pays

text: At 100%, Rina reviews the payment and confirms it.
callout: Five checks run again before paying

text: Each share is charged on its own, with its own receipt.
After discharge, the final bill decides what was overpaid.
The extra comes back, split by what each person paid.
The hospital's invoice is kept with the payment, with its fingerprint.
Now someone posts a new bank account in the chat.
Guardian warns everyone and pauses all payments.
Even the owner cannot pay while the warning is open.
callout: No override, not even the owner

text: Asking for medical records and card numbers is refused too.
Every action, allowed or blocked, goes into a hash-chained log.
callout: Edits to the log are detected

text: When everything is settled, Rina closes the case.
It becomes read-only, with records for every person.
One hundred twenty five automated tests pass.
Sixteen of sixteen live tasks and attacks pass.
A generic chatbot found two to four causes and invented an infection.
Guardian found all five causes and invented none.
Understand the bill. Pay together. Only to the hospital.
